text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 198, April 04, 1939 ]
MAKING ALLOTMENTS OF THE APPROPRIATIONS FOR THE PHILIPPINE ARMY AUTHORIZED
BY COMMONWEALTH ACT NO. 300, IN ADDITION TO THOSE INCLUDED IN EXECUTIVE
ORDER NO. 190, CURRENT SERIES, FOR EXPENDITURES OF THE EXECUTIVE DEPARTMENTS
OF THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT DURING THE PERIOD FROM JANUARY 1 TO JUNE 30, 1939
The following allotments of appropriations authorized by Commonwealth Act Numbered Three hundred are
made for the Philippine Army in addition to those included in Executive Order Numbered One hundred and
ninety, dated February twenty-eighth, nineteen hundred and thirty-nine, for expenditures of the executive
departments of the National Government during the period from January first to June thirtieth, nineteen
hundred and thirty-nine:
(8) PHILIPPINE ARMY
PURPOSE I.— PERSONNEL
Additional allotment
A. COMMISSIONED OFFICERS AND CADETS
B. REGULAR FORCE—ENLISTED MEN
C. REGULAR FORCE—TRAINEES
14. Clothing allowance
PURPOSE II.—MAINTENANCE. OF PERSONNEL
168. Subsistence of the regular force
169. Subsistence of trainees
The grand total of the funds allotted up to this date from the appropriations provided in Commonwealth Act
Numbered Three hundred, including those authorized in Executive Order Numbered One hundred and ninety,
current series, should, therefore, amount to thirty-eight million five hundred eighty-nine thousand four
hundred and seventy pesos.
Done at the City of Manila, this fourth day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and thirty-nine,
and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the fourth.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
JORGE B. VARGAS
Secretary to the President
